tier1.text: Each zygomatic bone, or cheekbone, forms much of the outer wall of the orbit, the bony eye socket. Each zygomatic bone also forms the front of the zygomatic arch, a bony bridge on the side of the skull.

sentences.text: Each zygomatic bone, or cheekbone, forms much of the outer wall of the orbit, the bony eye socket.

quotes.quote: The zygomatic bone is also known as the cheekbone. Each of the paired zygomatic bones forms much of the lateral wall of the orbit and the lateral-inferior margins of the anterior orbital opening
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: orbit: bony socket that contains the eyeball and associated muscles
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Each zygomatic bone also forms the front of the zygomatic arch, a bony bridge on the side of the skull.

quotes.quote: The short temporal process of the zygomatic bone projects posteriorly, where it forms the anterior portion of the zygomatic arch
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: Separating these areas is the bridge of bone called the zygomatic arch. The zygomatic arch is the bony arch on the side of skull that spans from the area of the cheek to just above the ear canal.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
